svg.title: Polaris — System Architecture
svg.desc: Architecture of the Polaris AI Research Orchestrator: Telegram and Eve channels feed an orchestrator agent that delegates to four specialist subagents (researcher, planner, analyst, writer) through an LLM Gateway routing between Groq primary and Google AI fallback. A shared Upstash Redis scratchpad provides cross-agent state. External APIs include Tavily, Jina, and Upstash.
